candidates.title: CompKV: Compensation-Aware KV Selection for Long-Context LLM Inference
candidates.reason: CompKV directly optimizes sparse KV selection for long-context inference and provides an asynchronous implementation with up to 6.85x self-attention speedup, strongly matching KV-cache and serving-efficiency lineages.

candidates.title: Flash-dLLM: IO-Aware KV Caching and Parallel Decoding for Fast, Memory-Efficient Diffusion LLMs
candidates.reason: Flash-dLLM identifies GPU memory I/O as a KV-cache bottleneck, introduces a fused cache kernel plus parallel draft-and-verify decoding, and reports 5.1x–11.0x speedups over the strongest cited baseline.

candidates.title: KV-COBRA: KV Cache Compression via Co-Optimized Bit-Rank Allocation
candidates.reason: KV-COBRA co-optimizes rank and bit width per attention head to improve extreme-rate KV compression with no per-token overhead, directly relevant to hierarchical memory and KV-cache compression.

candidates.title: Sigmoid Attention as a Better Substrate for Learned KV Cache Eviction
candidates.reason: The study directly evaluates learned hard KV eviction against H2O-style baselines and identifies attention normalization as a factor in transferring soft training gates to physical cache deletion.

candidates.title: Sliding-window beats linear attention
candidates.reason: This work compares a simple low-memory sliding-window attention baseline with post-trained linear attention and reports substantially stronger long-context results without post-training, providing practical efficient-attention deployment guidance.
